expectations.text: A tests/test_iologik*.py file exercises IoLogikE1212 with a faked pymodbus ModbusTcpClient (monkeypatched), no hardware
The trace shows the tests were written and run (with failures or xfails exposing findings) before the driver was edited
expectations.evidence: Tests written and run (failures shown) before the first driver Edit.

expectations.text: After the changes, IoLogikE1212.clear_fault() reopens the Modbus session (a new client/connect), and a test proves it
No test for a fixed finding is still marked xfail; any remaining xfail names a finding the report lists as still open

IoLogikE1212Api.write_do and read_all_di keep their names and signatures and the IoLogikE1212 constructor keeps ip_address, port, slave_id, name; the trace shows usages were searched before changing anything
The full tests/ suite passes in the final pytest run
The final response lists each finding with what was changed for it or why it stays open, and states what was not verified on hardware
expectations.evidence: Per-bug 'What was broken' / 'What I changed', questions, no-hardware statement.

expectations.text: devices/registry.py, app_logic/config.yaml and tests/test_registry.py are unchanged and no new config key or changed default (timeout, retries) was added; any such change appears only as a proposal
expectations.evidence: Changed devices/registry.py, app_logic/config.yaml and tests/test_registry.py: new timeout/retries keys with shorter defaults (1 s, 1 retry), unasked.
